runner_figures_checked.note: This is the first continuation-4 arm for which every runner figure I checked was already correct. Arm C, deepseek41, muse13 and union each needed at least one correction.

retry_structure.result: Every retry delivered where its first attempt had not. No lead was lost to truncation. The cost is that 12 admissions bought 9 distinct logical jobs.

cost.basis: priced from 404 native receipts at the preserved 2026-09-08 tariff basis
cost.comparability: Per-job limits match Arm C, deepseek41 and muse13 (40 responses, 2,400 s), so cost and duration are comparable with those three. NOT comparable with claude-hicap (authorized higher ceiling) or with the union arm (zero tariff, full pipeline).

leads.note: The three leads that reached compare without a delivery are J0027-compare's, which truncated at 40 responses with 81 source-locator receipts and no notes.md. Their reconcile work (J0023) is scored and carries 5 credits.

by_stage.reading: Unusually reconcile-weighted: 24 of 37 credits are first earned in a reconcile job. That is the opposite shape from the union arm (10 reconcile, 21 compare) and reflects that three of this arm's five compare jobs took Dojjo and diffedit3 leads whose reconcile work had already stated the propositions.

limits: One frozen case; a same-input review replacement. Recall is bounded by the premium arm's research artifacts.
Recall is against the adjudicated continuation-3 union, not an external exhaustive truth set.
'Unsupported or already-covered' is a union class, not a false-positive rate.
7 of 12 jobs were request-limited; request-limited coverage and the reached-delivery fraction are reported separately. Unperformed work remains unknown, never a negative finding.
Cost is a captured upper valuation at the preserved tariff basis, not a cash invoice.
